model_output.rationale: All three lines denied CO-22 (another payer primary), $0 paid, with MOA MA04. The 271 for DOS 2026-01-29 returns EB*R naming NOVITAS SOLUTIONS MEDICARE PART B FFS with "PLAN IS PRIMARY PAYER FOR THIS MEMBER", while the 837P was sent SBR*P to Liberty Bell. Coverage is active but misordered: bill Medicare Part B first, then rebill Liberty Bell as secondary with the primary's payment data. CO-22 is never patient-billable.

root_cause.explanation: 837P sent SBR*P (primary) to Liberty Bell; 271 for DOS 2026-01-29 shows EB*R with Novitas Medicare Part B FFS and MSG 'PLAN IS PRIMARY PAYER FOR THIS MEMBER'. All three lines denied CO-22, $0 paid, MOA MA04.

next_action.detail: Submit the 2026-01-29 claim (97110/97140/97530, GP) to Novitas Solutions Medicare Part B FFS as primary, CLM05-3=1. After its remit, rebill Liberty Bell as secondary: SBR01=S, 2320 SBR/AMT/CAS and 2430 SVD/CAS, balanced. Do not appeal; do not bill the patient. Medicare 1-year limit runs from DOS.
